model: PlasmaPro 100 Cobra ICP RIE with wide-temperature-range (cryo) electrode
family: ICP reactive-ion etch tool with LN2-cooled cryogenic electrode (cryo-DRIE)
description: Load-locked ICP-RIE process module (65 mm or 300 mm Cobra ICP source) for wafers up to 200 mm with He backside cooling and wafer clamping; the wide-temperature-range electrode is LN2-cooled to -150 C or heated to +400 C, used for cryogenic Si etching (SF6/O2) and compound-semiconductor processes.

configurations.configuration_basis: PlasmaPro 100 Cobra ICP RIE single process module with load lock and the wide temperature range electrode (LN2 cooling to -150 C, resistive heating to 400 C); blow-out/fluid exchange unit and cluster modules not included.
